oracleIndependence.modelBinding: Before pointerdown, resolve opaque native IDs once through current guarded shallow reads at the literal model paths; validate full expected types/text/topology. This binds IDs to preauthored roles, it does not derive expected endpoints.
oracleIndependence.domBinding: Resolve host.childNodes by the independent raw DOM path table; validate each literal tag/Text.data and expected child counts. Retain actual Text objects for identity comparisons. Never call production domPoint/readSelection or infer model roles from the observed selection.
oracleIndependence.opaqueIdPolicy: No fixed process tokens or authored DOM IDs; all document IDs unique and stable against recorded pregesture role mapping. Cloned attributes/IDs do not establish ownership.
oracleIndependence.membership: Per-leaf text slices and atom membership are selection oracles only, not a clipboard plain-text/separator specification.
oracleIndependence.utf16: PositionDto.text.offset stays UTF-16 code-unit count with scalar-boundary validation; no scalar ordinal conversion. New observed Text endpoints use after; separate bookmark tests retain explicitly captured before affinity.

withPadding.caretCaveat: Row-envelope arithmetic is feasibility only. Actual finite positive-height collapsed focus Range rect must still pass all four clip edges; do not substitute row/glyph/selection-union rect.

timingAndSamplingProposal.positiveAdvance: strict scrollTop delta in intended direction at distinct actual times while same pointerId/buttons remain held; no selection or wheel/scroll assist
timingAndSamplingProposal.activeEndTrigger: end immediately on second positive distinct observed scroll advance while directional range remains; retain bounded scroll-event/publication records as well as100ms checkpoints
timingAndSamplingProposal.activeWindowFailure: Reaching terminal before two qualifying advances with range remaining does not prove active stop; retain failed/unexercised case rather than relabel terminal release. Do not add direct scroll correction to create a window.
timingAndSamplingProposal.terminalRequirement: Reach exact preauthored model+rawDOM focus within8s while held, with unchanged anchor and actual full caret visible; mandatory in terminal_release cases.
timingAndSamplingProposal.transientInvariant: No fixed transient focus expected. Every published/sampled focus is valid owned scalar boundary, moves monotonically through the literal logical position order or stays equal; anchor exact at every publication/sample. Do not require unobservable intermediate selection epochs.
timingAndSamplingProposal.visibilityCheckpoints: Initial anchor, exact terminal while held, first settled end, and five stable samples require entire actual focus caret inside effective clip. In-progress samples record visibility honestly; transient owned/monotonic focus is separate from terminal literal.
timingAndSamplingProposal.rangeRectRule: collapse a fresh Range at actual raw focus; finite left/right/top/bottom, height>0 (width0 valid), all edges inside effective clip within0.5px. Missing usable rect is instrumentation failure, not a fabricated glyph rect.

setupAndOwnership: All explicit scroll positioning/font/geometry probes happen before pointerdown; down0/up1356 are fixed setup literals, not acceptance correction.

Move to literal anchor hit, pointerdown, verify exact collapsed anchor via independent model/DOM tables; then move once to frozen held x/y and keep pointer stationary. No model endpoint injection or reselection during/after gesture.
Record actual pointerId/buttons, pointer events and trust/protocol provenance, heldMs, all owner scroll positions, rawDOM/model points, resource baselines and actual caret/clip geometry.
After release/cancel require no pending controller RAF, capture or continuation and five stable100ms samples; page/clip and any discovered scroll owner also stable.
Synthetic controlled pointercancel proves only controlled handler cancellation. Native pointercancel needs a separately induced and retained trusted event; do not claim it from this12-case matrix.
Installed Chrome/Safari EN/RU physical drag/key proof remains a separate bounded host-owned lane after root freezes it; this data authorizes no native actions.
Firefox experimental label does not weaken any configured mandatory model/DOM/data/ownership oracle or hide fixture/font/instrumentation failures.
No clipboard47, IME41 settlement, domain, AT69 or stopped38 campaign completion is inferred.
